title: Rigbay module registry
description: The list of modules the Rigbay app can install. The app reads registry.json from the main branch of this repository, checks every rule below, and verifies the SHA-256 of a download against the value written here before it unpacks anything. scripts/validate.mjs checks the same rules (and a few that a schema cannot express: ascending versions, one id once, a zip of the same repository, a published release never changes).

id.description: Equal to the id in the module's module.json. Lowercase words joined by single dashes; rigbay, host, help, list and version are reserved.

icon.description: Optional. A .svg or .png file in the module's repository. The app does not fetch it in this version; it is kept for a later one.

versions.description: Oldest first, strictly ascending by semantic version. A published release is never edited; publish a new version.

version.description: Semantic Version 2.0. Equal to the version in the module.json inside the zip.

hostApi.description: The host API versions this release supports, as in module.json: space-separated comparators such as ">=0.1 <0.2".

zip.description: The release asset: https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/<tag>/<file>.zip, of the same repository as "repo". Nothing else is downloaded.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the zip, 64 lowercase hex digits.

size.description: Bytes of the zip, at most 64 MB.

declares.description: What the module.json inside the zip declares (requires and probePaths). The app shows it before the download and refuses the install when the manifest declares more than this.

outsideFiles.description: The probePaths of module.json: folders outside its own that the module reads files from.
